name: universal-browser-mcp
description: Private ChatGPT connection to the owner's Cloudflare Access-protected universal browser MCP for real website interaction, inspection and E2E testing.

interface.longDescription: Control an isolated Cloudflare Browser Run session through a protected MCP server. Inspect, navigate and test authorized websites. CRM is the first acceptance case; CRM admin capabilities remain disabled until owner-tenant identity onboarding.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open a permitted public website with Universal Browser MCP, inspect its interface and report verified results.
